title: The Way of Philosophy
body:
**The 'What' and 'Why' of Philosophy**

The human mind has always been fascinatingly curious,about understanding world,nature and all physical and abstract concepts since the beginning,which led to the foundation of many different subjects like Science,Mathematics,etc. All these subjects have been divided on the basis of their respective domains of application. And if we go deeper every single subject is later subdivided into many different branches of the subjects. For example, Science is divided into three main different branches or subjects, Physics,Chemistry and Biology and later on these three subjects are later subdivided into many other subjects.

Among all the subjects human have developed 'Philosophy' is one of the most interesting subjects.
The origin of Philosophy comes out of human's attempts to find the answers of the fundamental questions regarding Purpose and Truth of the 'Life' and 'Existence' 'Values' 'knowledge', etc.
It is subject that deals with fundamental questions regarding Life,Existence,Knowledge,Values and Language,etc. So we can say that this subject is indeed very vast

**Certain Traditions of Philosophy**

To seek the truth and meaning of life many minds developed their individual approaches which resulted in foundations of ideologies and thus founded different philosophical routes. Some major contributors in the field of Ancient Philosophy are: Socrates (greek),  Plato (greek), Sage Vyasa (Indian),etc.
The philosophical revolution of the ancient times gave rise to different ideologies and Philosophies such as 'Stoicism',Socratic questioning,etc.
Later in the medieval and modern era many philosophers emerged and contributed in the formation of new ideologies,for example Rene Descartes (French),Baruch Spinoza (Dutch), Friedrich Nietzsche (German),etc.

There are many Philosophy like Stoicism, 
Skepticism, Nihilism,  etc. Based on some fundamental ideologies,and many times these ideologies oppose one another. And interesting case is Existentialism vs Nihilism 
While the first steps of their ideologies look quite similar yet they don't have the same complete ideology about Purpose and Existence.
According to Existentialism,"Life and existence of one lacks predetermined Purpose and meaning one have to find his own Purpose in life."
While on the other hand Nihilism goes like this
"Life and Existence lacks any kind of Purpose or meaning and Purpose or value,and yet one have to accept life as it is. It questions the moral and societal norms and terms and their assumed meaning like Good or Bad,Right or Wrong, etc. "

Now in this example you can see a transparent contradiction in the ideologies even if both have almost similar prejudice about Life and Existence their approach to deal with the condition differs and thus,we can conclude that all the different philosophical ideologies or simply philosophies have contradictory approaches.

**'My' Way of Philosophy**

Here comes the part where I would like to sink all my heart in. As the title of this part suggests I have my own approaches towards Philosophy. 
So, my approach to Philosophy comes out of comparative analysis of certain ideology with my own experience and believes and I don't really follow one single philosopher or a number of philosophers rather my attention is generally concentrated on ideology proposed by the philosopher and therefore there are philosophers on whose many ideas I believe except a few and there are philosophers whose many ideas I reject except a few,cause I believe that any philosophical ideology is shaped through one's experience and his long way of thinking with a certain approach,also his early beliefs on the subject plays a main role in the formation of new ideologies,and hence we see many contradictions in different philosophies cause not only the experiences but also the way we perceive the experienced scenario/condition and we deduce the conclusion on the basis of the condition and our responses.
And hence,I came to conclusion that before accepting any philosophical ideology I should first examine with my own parameters,which are experiences and fundamental beliefs and my specific contradictory questions.
Here,before the end of this blog I want to include another important part
that one's beliefs should not be so weak that they can be shattered by any new ideology without having a comparative analysis and it should also not be so strict that it resists the genuinity of any truthful ideology or belief even if the new ideology of belief is actually found authentic.

(Lastly I would like to say thanks to you to read my blog. It is my first blog and I hope you like it. I am currently learning new things and expanding the domain of my knowledge.
If this blog was actually worth your time and if you have any questions or stuffs to share with me then let me know in the comments.
Once again Thanks a lot!!)

title: What I think about Life
body:
Hii,myself Aazad a weirdo,nerd,curious you can call me whatever you want so I actually came up with the idea of blogging to share my ideas about different subjects and create social public identity as a curious student in the field of understanding life and Universe along with sharing my opinions and stories to all the people around the world. This is my second blog kind of like on myself and my approach towards life really the moment I am writing this specific blog I feel that isn't it too quick to share about this specific topic like but on the other hand Iam really eager to share my thoughts and perspective over life and different topics.

**My Way of Life**

For me, life is not a game,a race or a circus it is rather a grand simulation made by God or by it's own and even if we have different purposes in life but still in my opinion we have fundamental and universal purpose which is survival,as we all know that everything we're doing is directly or indirectly for survival.
To survive doesn't only mean to live in my opinion survival is incomplete without happiness,hope and true sense of living simply 'Individual Purpose'.
And individual Purpose is important is important in your life cause it provides meaning to your survival (The first Purpose)
It is like the ornament of life and survival.
So all the three elements can later be subdivided into other elements or categories 
For example: Happiness the first element of survival can be categorised into family,friends,love and social,individual,physical and mental health.
But there is another important element which is equally important for all the three different elements and thus the survival as a whole but it can the the difference,which is 'Desire'.
Desire for power,authority,rights,individual identity,luxury or anything else,and this is something is hard to control cause it is not something which is directly related to Happiness (indirectly though) but with inner satisfaction. In my opinion,true satisfaction is hardly possible to get in a materialistic world cause you cannot get completely satisfied with anything there will always be a intention to get something else as soon you get something you earlier strived for. Now,I won't give you any usual suggestions to stop chasing everything because as I said it it is an important element of survival cause it also shapes your individual Purpose directly or indirectly,it is not wrong to have a desire until and unless the desire becomes an enemy of your natural Happiness. It is important to not let your desires suppress your natural Happiness and inner peace if your desires do so then it's time to pause and think rationally if your desire is good enough to chase for.

---




(So yeah it was the main part of the blog,I guess it's quite shorter than my previous one.I could actually expand it but I actually wanted to explain more concepts of the subject it was just an introduction to 'My Understanding about Life' so I wat cover rest concepts individually and details. So if you like this blog and or if you have any suggestions or opinions let me know in the guestbook.)

title: The Way of Stoicism
body:
**Introduction to Stoicism**

Stoicism is one of the most popular ancient Philosophies. Stoicism,  originally an Ancient Greek Philosophy is widely known due to its applications in normal society and individuals in the simplest form. The foundation of Stoicism dates back to around 300 BCE by Greek Philosopher Zeno of Citium. Later followers of this includes 'Marcus Aurelius' (Roman Emperor and Philosopher),'Epictetus' (Greek Philosopher),'Seneca' (Writer and Philosopher).

**The Way of Stoicism**

The main ideology of Stoicism is that "A person's character and personality are not shaped by the external events and circumstances before him but rather by the person's responses to them".
This can be the simplest explanation of the Stoic ideology but this I would like to add an example.
Imagine,yourself getting into a fight after a simple argument with your buddy. Now every word you say matters cause your response whether it is anger or peaceful negotiation will decide you will resolve the issue or tighten the tension of the situation.
Another simpler example is that imagine your riding a bike on a road,you're constantly increasing the speed of your bike out of craze of your new bike suddenly around a distance at few meters you see a speed breaker. Since it's your new bike you want to avoid any mishap that's obvious but you cannot control the speed breaker but you can control the speed of your bike just before the speed breaker.
According to Stoicism,Life goes the same way.you cannot control the occurrence of every obstacles in your life. You can only control the way you react to the obstacles,and that is what truly effects you and your life.
Life works on the principle of change.and that change occurs in the form of cause and effect but cause specifically is not only the situation you're in,but your response to that situation is what really shapes the actual cause and which in turns shapes the result.

**The Four Pillars of Stoicism**

Stoicism is based on four main pillars,these are the four 'Cardinal Virtues':
Prudence(wisdom),Justice,Fortitude(Courage),Temperance (Self Control).

Prudence or wisdom means understanding the difference between right and wrong. To make decisions wisely instead of emotionally.

Justice means to behave and work with honesty,rationality,due respect and righteousness.

Fortitude or Courage, To do the right even in fear and despair.

Temperance or self-control means to gain control over your emotions,desires and urges.

These are the four Cardinal Virtues of Stoicism.

**The Interpretation**

Many times,concepts get interpreted in a wrong sense due to lack of accurate understanding of certain ideas. In Philosophy this happens when one grasps the idea as it seems in literal sense.but philosophical concepts carry depth and they require a long way of thinking in order to achieve accurate or closely accurate understanding.
Same can be a case for Stoicism.
In Stoic ideology,controlling your emotions doesn't mean to become emotions it doesn't mean not to cry,not to be angry or not to express your emotions.but it means not to let every emotions be the master of you. Don't let your emotions and desires rule over your decisions and your inner self. As we discussed earlier that "don't make your decisions emotionally but wisely" as a part of one's wisdom. Stoic ideology gives stress on facing the problem with Courage,wisdom and self-control instead of escaping them.

**'My' Way of Stoicism**

In my opinion Stoicism is the simplest yet one of the most misinterpreted Philosophy. Also for most people Stoicism is just another ancient Philosophy losing it's value in today's world cause not everyone believe rationality or I should say (through my personal experiences) that rationality is more difficult to understand in today's world than keeping a single belief and following it. Also people's work ethics and personal way of life is constantly changing,also it is upon one's own will to follow a philosophical ideology or not
But one thing which anyone can follow,is the core ideology of Stoicism "One's Personality and character are shaped through one's responses to the external events and atrocities more than the external events themselves". Spend your energy on what you can control not on what you cannot.
Right now,out of everything that happening around you,not everything is in your control.The things which you can control are your actions at that time and since you're a part of the environment things will soon be in your favor or I should say your precise decisions will help you adapt you and the environment into favorability.



---

(Personally,I really wanted to write about this specific subject and it was a suggestion too.As I said earlier Stoic Philosophy is quite simple and that is why I like it though I really believe in analysising the Philosophy through my own method which I explained in my very first blog.
So,if you like this blog or you have any opinions or suggestions let me know in the comments)
